text:
## Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)  
Mandatory for high-risk customers and certain scenarios:  
**Trigger Scenarios:**
- Customer from high-risk country
- PEP (Politically Exposed Person) identified
- Beneficial ownership unclear
- Transaction pattern unusual
- Complaint or fraud history
- Regulatory concern identified  
**EDD Procedures:**
1. Enhanced identity verification (multiple documents)
2. Beneficial ownership verification (if customer is entity)
3. Source of funds verification
4. Ongoing transaction monitoring
5. Periodic review (annual minimum)
6. Documentation of risk assessment  
**Escalation:** Compliance Head approval required for EDD customers  
**See:** [[policy_aml]] for AML screening requirements

raw_entities.description: Policy mandating Enhanced Due Diligence procedures for high-risk customers and specific trigger scenarios. Establishes mandatory verification procedures, escalation requirements, and ongoing monitoring obligations for customers presenting elevated compliance risk.
context: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) Mandatory for high-risk customers and certain scenarios

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Identity Verification for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Requires collection and verification of multiple identity documents for customers triggering EDD procedures. This is a core procedural control within the Enhanced Due Diligence framework.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Verification for Entity Customers
raw_entities.description: Mandates verification of beneficial ownership structure when the customer is a legal entity rather than an individual. Required as part of EDD procedures.
context: Beneficial ownership verification (if customer is entity)

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Verification
raw_entities.description: Requires verification of the origin and legitimacy of customer funds as part of Enhanced Due Diligence procedures for high-risk customers.

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Transaction Monitoring for EDD Customers
raw_entities.description: Establishes requirement for continuous monitoring of transactions for customers subject to Enhanced Due Diligence, as part of ongoing compliance obligations.

raw_entities.name: Periodic EDD Review
raw_entities.description: Mandates periodic review of Enhanced Due Diligence assessments for high-risk customers at a minimum annual frequency to ensure continued appropriateness of risk classification.

raw_entities.name: Documentation of Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: Requires formal documentation and retention of risk assessments conducted for Enhanced Due Diligence customers, creating an audit trail of compliance decisions.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head Approval for EDD Customers
raw_entities.description: Mandates that the Compliance Head must provide explicit approval before a customer is classified as requiring Enhanced Due Diligence procedures.
context: Escalation: Compliance Head approval required for EDD customers

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Country Exposure
raw_entities.description: Risk category identifying customers domiciled in or conducting business from jurisdictions designated as high-risk for money laundering, terrorist financing, or sanctions violations. Triggers Enhanced Due Diligence procedures.

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Person Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk category for customers identified as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) or their close associates. Requires Enhanced Due Diligence due to elevated reputational and corruption risk.

raw_entities.name: Unclear Beneficial Ownership
raw_entities.description: Risk category triggered when the true beneficial owner or control structure of a customer entity cannot be clearly established. Requires Enhanced Due Diligence to identify and verify ultimate beneficial owners.

raw_entities.name: Unusual Transaction Pattern
raw_entities.description: Risk category identifying customers whose transaction behavior deviates from expected patterns or norms, potentially indicating money laundering, fraud, or other financial crime. Triggers Enhanced Due Diligence review.

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaint or Fraud History
raw_entities.description: Risk category for customers with documented history of complaints, fraud allegations, or previous suspicious activity. Requires Enhanced Due Diligence to assess ongoing risk.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Concern
raw_entities.description: Risk category triggered when regulatory authorities or internal compliance functions identify specific concerns about a customer's activities or profile. Mandates Enhanced Due Diligence procedures.

raw_entities.name: Multiple Document Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Control requiring collection and verification of multiple identity documents from high-risk customers as part of Enhanced Due Diligence. Strengthens identity verification beyond standard KYC procedures.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Verification Control
raw_entities.description: Control mechanism for verifying and documenting the beneficial ownership structure of entity customers, ensuring transparency of ultimate beneficial owners.
context: Beneficial ownership verification (if customer is entity)

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Verification Control
raw_entities.description: Control requiring verification and documentation of the origin and legitimacy of customer funds to prevent proceeds of crime from entering the banking system.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Transaction Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Ongoing monitoring control applied to transactions of Enhanced Due Diligence customers to detect suspicious patterns, unusual activity, or potential financial crime.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Documentation Control
raw_entities.description: Control requiring formal documentation and retention of risk assessments for Enhanced Due Diligence customers, creating an auditable record of compliance decisions and rationale.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance role responsible for approving Enhanced Due Diligence classifications and escalations. Acts as the final authority on EDD customer determinations.
context: Compliance Head approval required for EDD customers

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer classification for individuals or entities meeting one or more Enhanced Due Diligence trigger criteria, requiring enhanced verification, monitoring, and periodic review procedures.
context: Mandatory for high-risk customers and certain scenarios

Trigger Scenarios: Customer from high-risk country, PEP (Politically Exposed Person) identified, Beneficial ownership unclear, Transaction pattern unusual, Complaint or fraud history, Regulatory concern identified

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Person
raw_entities.description: Customer classification for individuals identified as Politically Exposed Persons or their close associates, requiring Enhanced Due Diligence procedures due to elevated compliance risk.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Enhanced KYC verification procedure requiring collection and verification of multiple identity documents for high-risk customers. Goes beyond standard identity verification to provide stronger assurance of customer identity.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Verification
raw_entities.description: Enhanced KYC procedure for verifying the beneficial ownership structure of entity customers, ensuring transparency of ultimate beneficial owners as part of Enhanced Due Diligence.
context: Beneficial ownership verification (if customer is entity)

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Verification
raw_entities.description: Enhanced KYC procedure requiring verification of the origin and legitimacy of customer funds, ensuring funds are not derived from illegal activities or sanctions violations.

raw_entities.name: Periodic EDD Review
raw_entities.description: Periodic review procedure for Enhanced Due Diligence customers conducted at minimum annually to reassess risk classification and verify continued appropriateness of enhanced procedures.

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Transaction Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Continuous AML screening procedure monitoring transactions of Enhanced Due Diligence customers to detect suspicious patterns, unusual activity, or potential financial crime indicators.
